tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a Azure workload for a customer in East US — set up a quote for B-series Bs (Burstable — B2s), override the default usage to 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) for the month, and pin the Standard tier since this is a regulated tenant.

Could you put together a D-series v5 (General Purpose — D4s_v5) quote? Always-on 1-month workload — use 730 VM-hours (1 month always-on) — and bill it out of East US 2, the Developer tier is fine, we don't need anything fancier.
Need to estimate F-series v2 (Compute Optimized — F4s_v2) sitting in Central US at about 100 instance-hours. We're on the Basic tier anyway.
Configure the calculator for E-series v5 (Memory Optimized — E4s_v5) in West US 2 — usage around 100 instance-hours per month and we're already on the Standard tier for the FedRAMP tenant.
What's the projected monthly bill for M-series (Memory Optimized — M64s) in West US 3 doing 730 VM-hours (1 month always-on), with the Basic tier attached?
Quick check — if I put 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) through NC-series (GPU — NC6s_v3) in Brazil South, on the None tier, what does the monthly estimate come to?
Hmm, what would B-series Bs (Burstable — B2s) cost me in Canada Central for a 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) monthly commitment if I add the Standard tier on top? Just want the number.

Pricing exercise for a finance review: configure the calculator for E-series v5 (Memory Optimized — E4s_v5) in West Europe, override usage to 100 instance-hours, leave support at the Basic tier, then tell me the all-in monthly total — they want it for the budget doc.

OK so I need to estimate D-series v5 (General Purpose — D4s_v5) running in North Europe for one month — use 730 VM-hours (1 month always-on) — and we're on the Developer tier; set it up in the calculator and give me the monthly figure.

Hey, can you set up an estimate for 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) out of UK South on NC-series (GPU — NC6s_v3) and tell me the monthly cost? We're on the Basic tier, but if it's over $1000/month we'll probably want to revisit.
